sources.snippet: How to Create Your Own AI Chatbot? - A Simple 6-Step Guide Now, let's learn how you can build your own AI chatbot. To keep it simple, we are going to use Botpress to build our chatbot's interface and logic. For the AI model that powers your chatbot, we are going to use GPT-4.
